purpose: detect verification/development wall-clock degradation across revisions
rules: record started_at for every major development/verification stage when that stage actually begins
duration_seconds of a completed non-final stage equals next_stage.started_at minus current_stage.started_at
record finished_at for the final stage and compute its duration_seconds as finished_at minus final_stage.started_at
for candidate shards preserve candidate_plan started_at -> shards started_at -> aggregate started_at -> next stage/finished_at; shard block duration is aggregate started_at minus shards started_at
never reconstruct invented timestamps after the fact; mark unavailable evidence explicitly if a timestamp was not captured
comparison: retain revision timing report and compare major stages/candidate contours against prior baselines; timing degradation is diagnostic evidence, not a reason to falsify or skip required checks
